05. Test cases and bug reports

A test case records conditions, steps and expected behavior; a bug report records reproducible
evidence of a mismatch.
Test case එJක් input, steps, expected result ලියනවා. Bug report එJක් actual result, environment

Q: What makes a good bug report?
A: Clear title, environment, reproducible steps, expected and actual results, evidence and impact.
